collins_definition.en: An area is a particular part of a town, country, region, or the world.
collins_definition.zh: 地区是城镇、国家、区域或世界的特定部分。

synonyms.nuance_explanation: More formal and often refers to larger, defined geographic areas.
synonyms.example_en: The mid region of the map is where most team fights happen in this meta.
synonyms.example_zh: 地图的中部区域是这个版本大多数团战发生的地方。

synonyms.nuance_explanation: Refers to a specific, often controlled or marked area, common in gaming contexts.
synonyms.example_en: Stay out of the enemy's smoke zone—you won't be able to see anything.
synonyms.example_zh: 待在敌方的烟雾区之外——你什么都看不见。

gaming_link.context: The A Site area on Bind has two entrances, making it a tough spot to defend.
gaming_link.zh: Bind地图的A区有两个入口，使它成为一个难以防守的位置。

collins_definition.en: If someone is against something, they oppose it or disagree with it.
collins_definition.zh: 如果某人反对某事，他们会反对或不同意它。

synonyms.nuance_explanation: Actively fighting or disagreeing with something, often used as an adjective.
synonyms.example_en: Our opposing team has a strong Jett player, so we need to focus her.
synonyms.example_zh: 我们的对手有一个很强的捷风玩家，所以我们需要针对她。

synonyms.nuance_explanation: Informal prefix meaning against, often used in compound words or casually.
synonyms.example_en: We need an anti-heal hero to counter their team's healing supports.
synonyms.example_zh: 我们需要一个克制治疗的英雄来对抗他们团队的治疗辅助。

gaming_link.context: Many people are against the new law because it limits personal freedom.
gaming_link.zh: 许多人反对这项新法律，因为它限制了个人自由。

collins_definition.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, you give it to them or make it available to them.
collins_definition.zh: 如果你提供某人需要或想要的东西，你会把它给他们或让他们可以使用它。

synonyms.nuance_explanation: Refers to providing something regularly or in large quantities, often resources.
synonyms.example_en: Creeps supply gold and experience to help you get your items faster.
synonyms.example_zh: 小兵提供金币和经验，帮助你更快地获得装备。

synonyms.nuance_explanation: More voluntary or polite; implies the recipient can choose to accept or not.
synonyms.example_en: I can offer to smoke the site if you want to push with me.
synonyms.example_zh: 如果你想和我一起推进，我可以为你封烟。

gaming_link.context: The hotel provides free breakfast for all guests.
gaming_link.zh: 酒店为所有客人提供免费早餐。

collins_definition.en: A point is a particular detail or fact that you consider or discuss.
collins_definition.zh: 要点是你考虑或讨论的特定细节或事实。

synonyms.nuance_explanation: Refers to the pointed end of something or a small piece of advice.
synonyms.example_en: The tip of your knife should hit the enemy's head for maximum damage.
synonyms.example_zh: 你的刀尖应该命中敌人的头部以获得最大伤害。

synonyms.nuance_explanation: A small, round mark or point, often used for positions or targets.
synonyms.example_en: Place the Spike on the dot in the center of the site for better coverage.
synonyms.example_zh: 把爆能器放在点位中心的标记上，以便更好地覆盖。

gaming_link.context: The main point of the presentation is to introduce our new product.
gaming_link.zh: 这次演示的要点是介绍我们的新产品。

collins_definition.en: If you follow someone, you go after them or come after them.
collins_definition.zh: 如果你跟随某人，你会跟在他们后面或在他们后面来。

synonyms.nuance_explanation: Implies following at a distance, often secretly or cautiously.
synonyms.example_en: Trail the enemy Sage to see if she's going to revive a teammate.
synonyms.example_zh: 跟踪敌方贤者，看看她是否要复活队友。

synonyms.nuance_explanation: Refers to following rules or orders, often with authority involved.
synonyms.example_en: Obey your team's shot caller to make sure everyone is on the same page.
synonyms.example_zh: 听从你团队的指挥，确保每个人都步调一致。

gaming_link.context: Please follow the instructions carefully to complete the task.
gaming_link.zh: 请仔细遵循说明来完成任务。
